evidence: ExoPlaSim runs of the design case, T21 with 10 layers and a 50 m mixed-layer sea, branched from its year-29 restart: the gases as their CO2 equivalent in PlaSim's own radiation, the glow as infrared added at the top of the air and carried down by PlaSim's broadband transmissivities, and the dimming as less sunlight. The control is the design case's own years 20-29; each run's years 10-19 are its climate. PlaSim's clouds and convection are Earth-tuned (climate/gcm/README, Clouds), and the rain-fed growth takes the light limitation study's water-limited land to grow in proportion to the water it evaporates. The held point is interpolated between the two glow runs, linearly in their dimming.
reading_rule: Means are area-weighted over the stated surface; precipitation and evaporation mm a day of water, evaporation upward; changes are run less control, relative changes in per cent of the control. Bands are |latitude| ranges of land. Dimming is per cent of the design sunlight. Growth is Gt C a year; its pairs are the light limitation study's [low, high] ends. first_means are W/m2, positive downward, over the first ten 3-day means of each branch less the branch it differs from (FAST). glow.held is the plan with the temperature held at the control's; pairs scales the gases' run to the other pairs in proportion to their warming.

made_up_by_plants.reference: CAM fixes 2-6 times as much carbon per litre as C3 and 1-5 times as much as C4 (Hartzell, Bartlett & Porporato 2018)
